name: rithanya-full-stack
description: Rithanya Hospital — monorepo (React 19.3 Vite client + Express + Prisma MySQL server). Backend serves built frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function c(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const a=path.join(s,e.name),b=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())c(a,b);else fs.copyFileSync(a,b);}};c('client/dist','server/public');console.log('[build] frontend synced to server/public');"
scripts.build:sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function c(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const a=path.join(s,e.name),b=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())c(a,b);else fs.copyFileSync(a,b);}};c('client/dist','server/public');console.log('[build] frontend synced to server/public');"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
